failure_summary.description: Returned expanded forms where the clue and context supported a shorter answer, such as adding a title or generic category noun.
Selected a related entity or unsupported broad category instead of the requested referent, or favored distracting evidence over details matching the full clue.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already covers concise answer granularity, requested answer slots, and checking candidates against the full clue and context. These failures indicate those rules were not applied; adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content.
